<details class="guide-section" open><summary>Task handover</summary>

1. Confirm the notebook saved its outputs in the supervisor-shared Drive folder.
2. Check that the segmentation aligns with the scan. Tell your supervisor if it does not.
3. Return to the portal and mark the task complete.

</details>
